text.arabic_uthmani: رِجَالٌۭ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَٰرَةٌۭ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

words.gloss_range: open class of morally steady persons of standing, functioning as the human subject across the ayah movement
words.root_gloss_range: footing, walking, manhood, and stature range, locally pressed toward responsible standing and firmness
words.prose: {{ar:رِجَالٌ}} ({{tr:rijālun}}) opens as an indefinite human class, not a closed named group. Its stature and footing pressure makes the people in the raised-house setting feel morally steady, while the boundary from 24:36 makes them the delayed human subject who carries the worship scene into practice. The ayah then unfolds their profile from resistance, to protected devotion, to fear of the Day. Same-surah echoes move the term from modesty and public-role contexts in 24:31 into this devotional profile, and sight moves from disciplined social gaze in 24:31 toward final perceptual overturning.

topics.headline: open class of steady persons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening noun presents a quality-bearing class of people with moral footing, not a previously identified group.
topics.reason: The indefinite plural and local lexical rows converge on open-class responsible stature.

topics.headline: subject carried over from 24:36
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human agents complete the raised-house worship frame begun in 24:36.
topics.reason: The boundary rows and attachment evidence support the cross-ayah grammatical and thematic handoff.

topics.headline: pivot noun for the ayah arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one opening noun anchoring the negated distraction clause and the later fear predicate.
topics.reason: The local clause structure makes the noun the visible anchor for the following predicates.

topics.headline: surah social term recast devotionally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same social term moving from modesty and public-role contexts such as 24:31 into a devotional profile in 24:37.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete same-surah recurrences, and the local use recasts the social category as exemplary steadiness.

words.gloss_range: initial negation that denies ongoing diversion and opens a neither-nor commercial frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the commercial refusal by negating the ongoing distraction verb. It is not just a bare no; it opens a frame that will be completed by the second negation, so the reader hears commerce being tested as a rival pull and found unable to move these people from devotion.

topics.headline: initial negation of ongoing diversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first negation denies habitual commercial capture, not merely one episode.
topics.reason: QAC and the CRITICAL rows support the first particle as negating the imperfect distraction predicate.

topics.headline: opened commercial exclusion frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first negation holding the sentence open until the second commercial item completes the neither-nor structure.
topics.reason: The paired negation rows are supported by the local coordination and second negation.

words.gloss_range: causative ongoing distraction by commerce, with the men as the attached affected object and the force negated
words.root_gloss_range: play, amusement, distraction, and heedless absorption range, locally causative attention-displacement
words.prose: {{ar:تُلْهِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:tulhīhim}}) gives commerce a causative pressure: it would make the men heedless, but the negation says that pressure fails. The feminine singular verb points back to trade as the grammatical subject, and the attached object suffix keeps the men visible as the intended targets. The broader play-and-amusement field is narrowed here to commercial attention-displacement, and against 102:1, where accumulation does divert, this word makes the same distraction mechanism fail. Its soft liquid-hā movement suits a subtle diversion that seeps attention away rather than striking openly.

topics.headline: trade as failed causative distractor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that trade is grammatically and semantically cast as the would-be causer of heedlessness, while the men remain the attached affected object who resist it.
topics.reason: The form, agreement, and suffix evidence support causative pressure aimed at the men.

topics.headline: distraction field reversed from 102:1
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices commerce as cognitive displacement, with the broader play-and-amusement field narrowed to a failed market pull here and contrasted with successful diversion in 102:1.
topics.reason: The root and intertext rows support attention-displacement while local negation reverses the outcome.

topics.headline: soft sound suits subtle diversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound note as a minor reinforcement of distraction that seeps attention away rather than a separate lexical sense.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a small recitational payoff and does not contradict the local parse.

words.gloss_range: trade as an indefinite activity-field and sustained livelihood pressure, paired with sale to cover commercial scale
words.root_gloss_range: commerce, trading, gain-seeking, and merchant activity range, locally an activity-field that fails to distract
words.prose: {{ar:تِجَارَةٌ}} ({{tr:tijāratun}}) names trade as an indefinite activity-field under negation. It is larger than one deal: livelihood, enterprise, and gain-seeking stand as the first commercial pressure. Paired with the later sale noun, it covers the macro scale of commerce, while 35:29 and 62:11 show how the same trade language can be either devotional metaphor or a rival pull.

topics.headline: indefinite trade as activity-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no category of trade, not just one transaction, is allowed to distract these people.
topics.reason: The indefinite gerund and lexical rows support broad commercial activity under negation.

topics.headline: trade and sale cover commercial scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paired commercial terms covering ongoing enterprise and the individual deal.
topics.reason: The local coordination with the sale noun supports the macro-micro commercial span.

topics.headline: trade language between devotion and distraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that trade can describe unfailing devotion in 35:29, while in 24:37 ordinary trade is denied power over devotion and contrasts with the pull seen in 62:11.
topics.reason: The concrete inter-ayah rows are coherent parallels and contrasts, locally narrowed by the negated commercial frame.

words.gloss_range: coordinating hinge that keeps the commercial negation open for a second item
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the commercial frame open. The connector makes the next noun a separately added distractor rather than a restatement, and its light hinge lets the listener hear the two commercial pressures as paired but distinct.

topics.headline: connector between commercial pressures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first commercial term extended to a second scale of exchange instead of closing after trade.
topics.reason: The conjunction is locally licensed as coordination inside the double-negation frame.

words.gloss_range: renewed negation giving the sale noun its own independent exclusion
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews the negation for the sale term. The second no is not filler; it gives the point transaction its own exclusion and completes the neither-nor architecture opened earlier.

topics.headline: second negation seals the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the individual sale is independently tested and denied, not merely included by implication.
topics.reason: The local particle cluster and coordinated noun support renewed negative scope.

words.gloss_range: sale or transaction event under negation, with exchange pressure narrowed to a point-action complement to trade
words.root_gloss_range: buying, selling, exchange, handclasp, and pledge range, locally a transaction event denied distracting power
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْعٌ}} ({{tr:bayʿun}}) narrows the commercial test to the transaction event. Its exchange and pledge-handclasp pressure makes the market pull tactile, while the indefinite noun under its own negation excludes any point sale. Together with trade, it closes the commercial field from enterprise down to the immediate deal, and it recalls the suspension of sale for remembrance of God in 62:9.

topics.headline: any sale event excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that not even a single transaction event is allowed to divert these people.
topics.reason: The indefinite gerund under the second negation supports broad exclusion at the transaction level.

topics.headline: handclasp and exchange pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sale noun carrying concrete exchange pressure, with pledge-handclasp associations present as lexical pressure rather than the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The lexical rows are locally narrowed to transaction imagery and do not replace the sale sense.

topics.headline: completion of the commercial merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sale completing the macro-micro pair with trade and linking the commercial suspension motif to remembrance of God, especially in 62:9.
topics.reason: The local pair and concrete remembrance-commerce comparison support the sequence payoff.

words.gloss_range: away-from preposition marking separation from the devotional objects and governing the whole protected chain
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) gives the distraction clause its direction: away from the protected devotional objects. One preposition governs the following coordinated chain, so remembrance, prayer, and zakat all stand as the place from which commerce cannot pull them. The compact nasal particle also audibly binds the away-from relation to the first protected object.

topics.headline: away-from preposition over the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the issue is separation away from devotion, with one preposition governing all three protected practices and audibly binding into the first object.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence shows the preposition governing the first genitive and the coordinated devotional chain.

words.gloss_range: remembrance, mention, and invocation of God as the first protected devotional practice
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, invoking, and reminder/scripture range, locally remembrance and invocation of God
words.prose: {{ar:ذِكْرِ}} ({{tr:dhikri}}) begins the protected chain with remembrance of God. The construct binds remembrance to its object, so the practice is not generic mindfulness; it is memory, mention, and invocation directed to God. Masculine-prominence and scripture associations remain wider root pressure, while local grammar selects remembrance and invocation. The sequence moves from inward remembrance toward embodied and material practice, linking the active human profile back to the naming and invocation mandate of 24:36.

topics.headline: construct remembrance of God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first protected object is remembrance directed to God, bound by the construct phrase.
topics.reason: Local genitive attachment supports the construct relation and object-directed remembrance.

topics.headline: memory mention and invocation range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remembrance as an ongoing practice of memory, mention, and invocation rather than a single mental event.
topics.reason: The lexical rows fit the local maṣdar and do not overrun the construct frame.

topics.headline: masculine and scripture associations narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wider root associations exist, but local grammar selects remembrance and invocation rather than making masculinity or scripture the local sense.
topics.reason: These rows carry lexical pressure, but the construct phrase and local devotional chain narrow the selected sense.

topics.headline: first term in devotional chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remembrance as the first protected practice, linking the mandate of 24:36 to an inner-first chain that moves outward.
topics.reason: The sequence and formula rows are supported by the local coordinated chain.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name anchoring remembrance and the whole protected devotional chain
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deity, and disputed bewilderment/worship derivation range, locally fixed as the proper divine name
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) fixes the object of remembrance with the proper divine name. The form makes the protected practice explicitly God-directed, while derivational discussions of worship and bewilderment remain background pressure around the name rather than alternate local referents. The name also anchors the prayer and zakat sequence that follows, with the God-conscious address of 24:30 resonating behind the same surah's devotional discourse.

topics.headline: proper divine name in genitive slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remembrance is fixed to the unique divine referent, not a generic deity term.
topics.reason: The QAC row and proper-noun form support the fixed referent in the construct.

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment derivation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the worship and awe pressure around the name, while the local construct keeps the proper name as the selected function.
topics.reason: The derivational rows are valid as lexical pressure but are narrowed by the local proper-name use.

topics.headline: semantic anchor of the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine name binding remembrance, prayer, and zakat into one God-directed devotional profile, with same-surah resonance against 24:30.
topics.reason: The local chain and same-surah rows support the name as semantic anchor.

words.gloss_range: coordinating hinge extending the protected chain from remembrance to established prayer
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the protected chain from remembrance to prayer. The conjunction keeps the new practice under the same away-from governance and adds a measured cadence to the three genitive practices.

topics.headline: connector into embodied practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the chain moving from inner remembrance into established prayer without leaving the prepositional scope.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second devotional term under the same governance.

words.gloss_range: establishing or upholding prayer, with standing/uprightness pressure narrowed to the ritual practice
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, straightening, and upholding range, locally establishment of prayer
words.prose: {{ar:إِقَامِ}} ({{tr:iqāmi}}) names the establishing of prayer. The shortened construct form binds the action to the known prayer, and the root's standing/uprightness pressure makes the practice feel upheld, set on its feet, and kept in order. The recurring establishment-of-prayer formula, as in 2:3 and 2:43, and the Day-of-Standing resonance remain supports, not replacements for the local prayer-establishment sense.

topics.headline: construct-bound establishing form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices establishment as a formal maṣdar bound to prayer, not a loose mention of standing.
topics.reason: The construct and Form IV rows support causative establishment of the prayer object.

topics.headline: standing and uprightness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer establishment carrying uprightness and standing pressure, with resurrection-field echoes such as the Day of Standing kept as resonance.
topics.reason: The root-pressure and formula rows are locally narrowed to establishing prayer while preserving the standing resonance.

words.gloss_range: the known prayer practice as the definite object of establishment and partner of almsgiving
words.root_gloss_range: prayer, connection, blessing, and following range, locally the known prayer institution
words.prose: {{ar:الصَّلَاةِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣalāti}}) is the known prayer practice being established. Its definiteness makes this an institution, not an undefined act, and the prayer-zakat pairing points forward to 24:56 while remaining part of the protected chain here. Etymological connection or following pressure stays subordinate to the local practice sense.

topics.headline: known prayer institution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer as the definite established practice and object of the preceding establishing noun.
topics.reason: The definite noun and attachment evidence support objecthood inside the construct.

topics.headline: connection and following pressure narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices connection and following pressure behind the prayer term, while local grammar keeps the known prayer practice selected.
topics.reason: The etymological rows are preserved as pressure but narrowed by the definite institutional use.

topics.headline: prayer and zakat formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer paired with zakat here and anticipated again in the command of 24:56.
topics.reason: The formulaic rows match the local coordinated devotional pair and concrete same-surah reference.

words.gloss_range: coordinating hinge completing the protected three-part devotional chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) completes the three-part chain by adding the giving practice. The connector keeps the third item under the same protected scope and gives the end of the chain a matching cadence with the preceding establishing term.

topics.headline: connector completing the ternary chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the protected devotional sequence closing with a third coordinated practice rather than stopping at prayer.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the third protected object under the same preposition.

words.gloss_range: giving or delivering the alms due as a formal practice, with caused-arrival pressure in the act of transfer
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving range, locally caused delivery of zakat
words.prose: {{ar:إِيتَاءِ}} ({{tr:ītāʾi}}) makes zakat something delivered. The Form IV giving sense can be felt as caused arrival: the due is made to reach its place, while the recipient remains unstated. As the third term, it carries the chain from inner remembrance and embodied prayer into material transfer, and it anticipates recompense in 24:38.

topics.headline: zakat as delivered object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the due as the object made to be delivered, with the recipient left outside the word.
topics.reason: The construct and verbal-noun rows support zakat as the delivered object.

topics.headline: giving as caused arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices giving as making the due arrive, not merely letting go of property.
topics.reason: The coming/giving root rows fit Form IV transfer and are locally narrowed to the zakat object.

topics.headline: third practice and recompense link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the chain ending in material giving, which is answered by divine recompense in 24:38.
topics.reason: The sequence and boundary rows are supported by the local third position and next-ayah purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: the known zakat due as purified and growth-bearing obligation, object of the giving practice
words.root_gloss_range: purity, growth, increase, and purification range, locally the known obligatory due
words.prose: {{ar:الزَّكَاةِ}} ({{tr:al-zakāti}}) names the known due, not an optional gift. Its purification and growth range makes the transfer more than payment: the obligation carries cleansing and increase pressure while remaining the definite zakat object paired with prayer across the formulaic field.

topics.headline: definite zakat due
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object as the known obligatory due governed by giving, not a voluntary generic gift.
topics.reason: The definite genitive noun is locally attached as the object of the giving practice.

topics.headline: purification and growth pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the due carrying both purification and growth pressure, so the material transfer is morally generative.
topics.reason: The lexical rows support purity-growth pressure without displacing the local zakat sense.

topics.headline: prayer-zakat bond
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices zakat locked to prayer in a persistent devotional doublet.
topics.reason: The local pair and distributional rows support the formulaic bond.

words.gloss_range: ongoing informed fear by the same men, functioning as the positive eschatological predicate
words.root_gloss_range: fear, apprehension, and informed anticipation range, locally ongoing judgment-oriented fear
words.prose: {{ar:يَخَافُونَ}} ({{tr:yakhāfūna}}) turns from what commerce cannot do to what these same men actively carry: ongoing fear of a Day. The pro-dropped subject still points back to the opening men, so their resistance is motivated by informed anticipatory fear rather than mere detachment from the market. This second predicate opens the eschatological scene that explains the conduct.

topics.headline: same men in ongoing fear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same agents moving from immunity to a positive predicate of ongoing fear.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb and pro-drop subject support continuity with the opening noun.

topics.headline: judgment-oriented fear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fear as informed anticipation within a recurrent judgment-day field, not panic detached from knowledge.
topics.reason: The root and recurrence rows fit the local feared-Day object.

topics.headline: fear clause opens final scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the fear clause balancing the negated commercial pull and preparing the next-ayah valuation in 24:38.
topics.reason: The local predicate sequence and boundary rows support this scene function.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite feared Day, specified by the overturning clause and charged as decisive time
words.root_gloss_range: day, time, period, and decisive occasion range, locally the feared eschatological Day
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمًا}} ({{tr:yawman}}) leaves the feared Day indefinite at first, then lets the following clause define it. The accusative can be heard as feared object or temporal frame, and the tanwīn makes the Day weighty and unnamed before its internal event is disclosed. As decisive time, it resonates with judgment-day language and the q-l-b overturning scene; it pivots the ayah from the men's fear into the overturning of hearts and sights, then forward toward recompense in 24:38.

topics.headline: indefinite feared Day specified later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an unnamed Day becoming identifiable only through the overturning clause that follows.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite noun and following pronoun clause support the specification.

topics.headline: decisive eschatological time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Day as decisive time resonating with judgment-day language and q-l-b upheaval.
topics.reason: The lexical and recurrence rows fit the local eschatological frame.

topics.headline: pivot into overturning and recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Day moving the sentence from fear into the final overturning scene and forward toward 24:38.
topics.reason: The sequence and boundary rows support the pivot function.

words.gloss_range: Form V overturning as unfolding internal state-change of hearts and sights, with variant agreement pressure kept as apparatus
words.root_gloss_range: turning, inversion, reversal, and fluctuation range, locally Form V overturning of faculties
words.prose: {{ar:تَتَقَلَّبُ}} ({{tr:tataqallabu}}) makes the feared Day an unfolding state of overturning. Form V centers the faculties undergoing reversal, not an external turner, and the q-l-b root makes inversion of state the scene's core image. Variant agreement and compressed recitation forms are useful apparatus: they sharpen how the broken plural can be heard, while the canonical wording treats the overturning as a collective event of hearts and sights. The verb and the following hearts noun share the turning root, so the closure becomes a sound-sense climax distinct from the diseased-heart state in 24:50.

topics.headline: canonical agreement with variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the canonical feminine agreement treating the broken plural collectively, while variant and recitational pressures expose other ways the turning can be heard.
topics.reason: Accepted variant and recitational rows are preserved as apparatus without replacing the canonical parse.

topics.headline: Form V internal overturning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices physical inversion mapped onto inner and perceptual destabilization through a marked Form V state-change.
topics.reason: The form and root rows support internal or medio-passive overturning rather than a completed external flip.

topics.headline: root echo and eschatological climax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb and hearts sharing the turning root, making the final clause a sound-sense climax distinct from diseased-heart language in 24:50.
topics.reason: The echo, sound, and same-surah rows converge on the closing overturning scene.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun that makes the feared Day the temporal container of overturning
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) locks the relative clause back onto the feared Day. The pronoun points to the indefinite Day, making it known by what happens inside it, while the preposition turns the Day into the temporal container that the overturning fills. Against the house-locations of 24:36, location language shifts into destabilizing time.

topics.headline: pronoun tethers clause to the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the suffix making the unnamed Day identifiable through the overturning event.
topics.reason: The pronoun and attachment evidence support reference back to the indefinite Day.

topics.headline: from sacred space to feared time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same basic in-relation moving from sacred houses in 24:36 to a Day that contains upheaval.
topics.reason: The preposition and boundary rows support the temporal-container payoff.

words.gloss_range: the definite broken-plural hearts as inner faculties undergoing the root-echoed turning
words.root_gloss_range: turning, heart, inner center, and fluctuation range, locally hearts as inner faculties that undergo overturning
words.prose: {{ar:الْقُلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-qulūbu}}) names the hearts as the first subject of the overturning. The definite broken plural gathers inner centers as a recognizable faculty class, and the shared q-l-b root makes the hearts enact the turning pressure embedded in their name. The result is cognitive and spiritual disruption, not only emotional distress.

topics.headline: definite broken-plural subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hearts gathered as a whole inner-faculty class undergoing the verb, not merely observing it.
topics.reason: The nominative definite broken plural is locally subject of the overturning verb.

topics.headline: hearts perform their name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word for hearts sharing the turning root with the verb, so the named faculty enacts its own instability.
topics.reason: The root and echo rows support the sound-sense figure.

topics.headline: inner perception destabilized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hearts as loci of perception and judgment, contrasting the stable worship frame of 24:36 with inner disorientation.
topics.reason: The perception-pair and boundary rows are coherent with the local hearts-and-sights subject cluster.

words.gloss_range: final conjunction that makes hearts and sights one compound subject of the overturning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the final scene from stopping with hearts. The conjunction makes sights share the same overturning verb, joining inner evaluation and outward seeing into one compound subject, with a brief audible hinge before the final perception noun.

topics.headline: hearts and sights joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final conjunction extending the same destabilizing event from inner hearts to outward sight.
topics.reason: The local coordination makes the final noun share subjecthood under the same verb.

words.gloss_range: the definite sight faculties as the final coordinated subject, extending the crisis from inner judgment to perception and insight
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, sight, perception, insight, and clear evidence range, locally sight faculties destabilized at the close
words.prose: {{ar:الْأَبْصَارُ}} ({{tr:al-abṣāru}}) closes the ayah on sight. As a definite plural noun, it names the faculty itself, not merely an act of seeing, and its root range reaches perception and insight as well as eyesight. Paired with hearts rather than hearing, the final word makes the Day a collapse of inner judgment and outward orientation; 24:35 and the surah's sight motif make the closing landing especially pointed. The long ā and final rā give that last perception noun a broad resonant finish.

topics.headline: definite sight faculty as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sight itself gathered as a faculty class and made subject to the final reversal.
topics.reason: The definite plural noun is coordinated as subject under the overturning verb.

topics.headline: sight and insight destabilized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the crisis reaching both physical sight and discernment, paired with hearts as inner and outer orientation.
topics.reason: The root and semantic field rows support perception beyond optics while local grammar keeps sight as the headword.

topics.headline: heart-sight pair instead of hearing-sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sight paired with hearts rather than the common hearing-sight pair, tying the closure to cognition and to the light/sight context of 24:35.
topics.reason: The pair-contrast and same-surah rows are concrete and locally supported by the coordinated subject.

topics.headline: final perception landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending on the perception noun, with sound weight reinforcing the semantic closure.
topics.reason: The closure and sound rows add a real endpoint payoff without changing the lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated causative at word 3 makes trade and sale potential diversions from the coordinated acts of remembrance, maintained prayer, and zakat.
baseline_models.mechanism: Economic activity remains active, but it is denied authority to redirect attention. Remembering, maintaining prayer, and transferring zakat form a continuous governing sequence rather than occasional interruptions of work.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied away from one object by another supplies the diversion that the negation blocks.
Profit-seeking circulation supplies the continuing economic pressure competing for attention.
Exchange for a price supplies the concrete transaction that must remain subordinate.
Held or recovered presence in the heart supplies the attentional center from which work cannot pull them.
Care, preservation, and sustained charge turn prayer from an episode into something kept standing.
Obligatory worship supplies the maintained practice governed by that sustained charge.
Giving and delivery supply an outward transfer rather than inward attention alone.
Purification and rectification make the transfer ethically formative as well as financial.

changed_reading.before: Devout merchants pause business to perform religious duties.
changed_reading.after: These agents remain inside economic circulation while refusing its power to reorient attention; remembrance, sustained prayer, and purifying transfer govern the circulation itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Profit-seeking trade and priced exchange are set beside giving whose root can signify growth, while the establishment root also carries valuation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence quietly contests the market's account of gain. What leaves the possessor as zakat is figured as growth and purification, while pricing and profit are placed under a nonmarket measure sustained by prayer.

activation_trace.role: The pursuit of profit supplies the ordinary definition of increase being challenged.
Price-based exchange supplies the ordinary mechanism for assigning value.
Valuation and appraisal let the establishment construction carry a secondary question about what truly counts.
Actual delivery makes value leave one's possession rather than remain an intention.
Growth and increase recast outgoing zakat as productive yield rather than depletion.

changed_reading.before: They balance earning money with charitable payment.
changed_reading.after: The focus verse places two economies in tension: priced profit is subordinated, while disciplined giving is presented as the form of increase that truly keeps value standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root names both the repeated turning and the hearts, and the turning extends to sights on a severe day.
baseline_models.mechanism: The feared event destabilizes both the inward faculty that judges and the outward faculty that registers evidence. Present attentional steadiness is therefore anticipatory training for a day when neither inner orientation nor visible bearings can be presumed stable.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of a signaled harm supplies active foresight rather than vague anxiety.
A day understood as a severe event gives the temporal marker catastrophic weight.
The heart as organ of understanding supplies the inward faculty exposed to upheaval.
Turning something from face to face supplies the repeated reversal acting on that inward faculty.
Ocular seeing supplies the outward evidence channel that is overturned alongside the heart.
Insight supplies the further possibility that both physical sight and discernment lose their settled orientation.

changed_reading.before: They fear the Day of Judgment.
changed_reading.after: They anticipate a day of double epistemic reversal, when the inward judge and the outward evidence channel both turn; their present non-distraction is a practiced steadiness before that loss of bearings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding light and raised-house sequence makes the focus agents the human maintainers of a luminous devotional environment. Their resistance to distraction is spatial and communal: it keeps remembrance and praise operative inside houses across the day's rhythm.

activation_trace.role: Diversion away from a governing object supplies the threat to the house's attentional practice.
Sustained care supplies the human maintenance needed by the devotional environment.
Layered illumination supplies the perceptible medium that the following household practice embodies.
Dwelling and shelter give the illumination a social location rather than leaving it abstract.
Raising something supplies the deliberate elevation and upkeep of that location.
Worship through praise and prayer supplies the activity that fills the raised houses before the agents are named.

structural_cues: 24:35 presents layered light, 24:36 locates remembrance and praise in raised houses, and 24:37 immediately names the agents whose work does not interrupt it.
The morning-evening rhythm in 24:36 makes non-distraction continuous across ordinary working time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, raised dwellings, rhythmic praise, and then non-distracted agents. I infer that their practices functionally maintain the luminous social space; alternatively, the sequence may only locate devotion in houses without making human constancy causally light-bearing.

changed_reading.before: Individuals keep private devotion despite commercial demands.
changed_reading.after: They are custodians of a shared luminous ecology: commerce continues, but cannot extinguish the remembered, prayed, and giving life of the raised houses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The slander and modesty sequences turn sight from passive reception into an accountable practice. Untested speech moves from tongue to tongue, limbs later testify, and eyes must be deliberately restrained; the focus's overturning hearts and sights now threatens faculties already responsible for how social reality is produced.

activation_trace.role: Repeated reversal supplies the final destabilization of inward orientation.
Seeing supplies the focus faculty whose prior use becomes accountable.
The speaking organ supplies the channel by which an ungrounded report is socially propagated.
Presence joined to witnessing turns bodily members from instruments into evidence bearers.
Deliberate lowering by restraint supplies an ethics for controlling visual intake.
The same ocular faculty appears earlier as something to govern before it is overturned.
Guarding and watchful care supply the maintenance discipline paired with restrained sight.

structural_cues: 24:12-18 repeatedly sequence hearing, supposition, speech, and absent knowledge; 24:24 then makes bodily organs witnesses.
24:30-31 symmetrically command governance of sight before 24:37 pairs sights with turning hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed report discipline, bodily testimony, restrained gaze, and final visual upheaval. I infer that disciplined perception and transmission help stabilize the present heart; alternatively, the legal-social and eschatological scenes may remain parallel accountability domains without a direct causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The future day simply frightens hearts and eyes.
changed_reading.after: The future reversal exposes the fragility of faculties already charged with producing truthful social knowledge; non-distraction includes disciplined seeing, hearing, and transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lightning nearly removes sight, God turns night and day, and that alternation is an admonitory crossing for possessors of sight. The focus's turning hearts and sights is thus the terminal form of a reversal pattern already visible in weather and time.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face reversal supplies the focus event that the cosmic sequence amplifies.
Insight supplies the capacity that should learn from present reversals before final upheaval.
Ocular vision is shown as physically vulnerable to a sudden flash.
Divine turning of alternating conditions supplies an exact contextual echo of the focus reversal.
Night and its darkness supply one pole of the recurring cosmic alternation.
Day opening in light supplies the opposed pole that repeatedly replaces night.
Taking one condition as an admonition for another makes cosmic alternation training for judgment.
Possessors of insight are the intended learners from the visible reversal.

structural_cues: 24:43 moves from cloud assembly to a flash that nearly takes sight; 24:44 immediately names divine turning and addresses possessors of sight.
The exact turning-root recurrence links the context's night-day alternation to the focus's turning hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vulnerable eyes, divine alternation, and an explicit lesson for sight. I infer that recurrent cosmic reversals rehearse the final reversal and calibrate the agents' fear; alternatively, the shared root may mark analogy without making natural alternation preparatory training.

changed_reading.before: Fear concerns one remote catastrophic day.
changed_reading.after: Every alternation of dark and light can rehearse that day: those with insight read present reversals as training for the final turning of inward and outward sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's trade, sale, and growth-bearing zakat flow directly into recompense, divine increase, gifted provision without reckoning, and then a mirage mistaken for water. Market calculation is not abolished; it is displaced by a true yield whose source exceeds calculation and by a final account that exposes false returns.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking supplies the economic calculation that the next verses remeasure.
Priced exchange supplies the finite transactional horizon placed under a wider account.
Growth carried by giving supplies the focus's paradoxical form of yield.
Return proportioned to action supplies a true settlement for the agents' work.
Increase and growth explicitly continue the focus's question of genuine gain.
Gifted beneficence makes the increase exceed a wage-like exchange.
An apportioned gift supplies provision from outside the trader's own calculation.
Counting and reckoning supply the measure explicitly exceeded by provision.
A waterlike gleam that is not water supplies the false appearance of profitable return.

structural_cues: 24:38 immediately answers the focus practices with recompense, increase, grace, provision, and reckoning vocabulary.
24:39 immediately reverses apparent yield into a mirage and final settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dense sequence of trade, giving, growth, reward, increase, provision, reckoning, and mirage. I infer that this sequence critiques self-enclosed market valuation; alternatively, the reward and mirage images may contrast belief and unbelief generally without targeting economic calculation as such.

changed_reading.before: Worshippers receive extra reward for choosing duty over business.
changed_reading.after: Their giving participates in a true economy of unpriced increase, while returns visible only to profit-calculation can prove mirage-like when the final account arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later verses distinguish a diseased heart's suspicious fear that divine judgment may be biased from reverent fear joined to hearing and obedience. The promise then replaces fear with security. The focus agents' fear is therefore selective and productive: it prevents opportunistic turning away and forms the integrity through which security can emerge.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of coming harm supplies the focus's future-facing vigilance.
The heart as understanding faculty supplies the site in which corrupt fear and doubt are diagnosed.
Departure from sound balance supplies the pathology behind interest-driven response to judgment.
Agitated doubt supplies the alternative motive contrasted with disciplined fear.
Fear of biased treatment supplies the misdirected form of the same affect.
Deviation in judgment identifies what the suspicious heart wrongly projects onto divine rule.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the sound response to adjudication.
Willing submission supplies action that does not change with immediate advantage.
Fear joined to awe supplies the correctly oriented counterpart to suspicious fear.
One condition taking the place of another supplies the promised conversion of fear into security.
The repeated fear root marks the condition transformed rather than allowed to dominate.

structural_cues: 24:47-51 contrasts declared obedience with turning away when judgment is not advantageous.
24:50 and 24:52 place diseased suspicion and reverent fear in direct contrast; 24:55 then replaces fear with security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two differently oriented fears, stable obedience, and a promised replacement by security. I infer that focus fear causes integrity by displacing opportunistic fears; alternatively, reverent fear and public security may be associated outcomes without a direct psychological sequence.

changed_reading.before: Their fear is simply dread that competes successfully with commercial desire.
changed_reading.after: Their fear is an orienting allegiance: it rejects suspicion and advantage-sensitive obedience, steadies conduct, and is ordered toward the transformation of social fear into security.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving in the focus becomes part of a wider refusal to let ownership and worldly return govern persons. The surah requires continued gift after injury, contribution to an emancipation contract from wealth understood as given by God, and refusal to coerce vulnerable women for transient gain.

activation_trace.role: Profit pursuit supplies the pressure that can turn every relation into a source of gain.
Price exchange supplies the transactional form that must not govern persons or devotion.
Giving as actual delivery anchors the focus in material transfer.
Purifying rectification makes transfer repair a social relation rather than merely move property.
Possessed surplus as beneficence supplies the capacity that must remain available to others after conflict.
Continued delivery to kin, the needy, and migrants supplies restorative giving despite injury.
Leaving punishment and erasing offense prevents resentment from stopping material support.
A written emancipation arrangement supplies a transaction ordered toward releasing rather than owning a person.
Possessed wealth supplies the resource explicitly reframed as God's grant and shared onward.
Forcing another into what she rejects supplies the prohibited conversion of power into profit.
Transient worldly goods supply the short-lived return for which commodifying coercion is condemned.

structural_cues: 24:22 links giving to pardon after communal injury.
24:33 juxtaposes contract, God's wealth, contribution, coercion, and transient worldly return, giving the focus's trade-versus-zakat contrast a direct social test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restorative gift, an emancipation contract, divinely sourced wealth, coercion, and worldly return. I infer a boundary: legitimate exchange must serve release and repair rather than price persons; alternatively, these commands may regulate separate abuses without constituting one anti-commodification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Zakat is the charitable counterpart that balances otherwise neutral trade.
changed_reading.after: Zakat belongs to a social economy that disciplines ownership: wealth must repair ruptures and enable release, while profit is forbidden from converting vulnerable persons into merchandise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later privacy rule uses prayer to partition household time. Establishing prayer in the focus therefore does more than preserve a rite amid commerce; it erects a temporal framework within which access, exposure, rest, and work are coordinated.

activation_trace.role: Establishing residence or duration supplies the sense of prayer occupying durable temporal stations.
Obligatory worship supplies the recurring practice capable of organizing the day.
The counted threefold division supplies a stable household schedule.
Two named prayers function as public temporal boundaries for private access.
A determinate occasion supplies the midday boundary coordinated with the prayer markers.
Protected exposure supplies the social vulnerability that liturgical time helps govern.

structural_cues: 24:36 already places praise at morning and evening; 24:58 later marks household permission around dawn prayer, midday undressing, and evening prayer.
The focus's establishment noun sits between uninterrupted work and a surah-wide scheduling of communal and domestic life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring prayer markers and privacy boundaries. I infer that maintained prayer functions as shared timekeeping infrastructure; alternatively, the prayers may be convenient clocks for an independently grounded privacy rule.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a duty preserved from interruption by business.
changed_reading.after: Maintained prayer is also a public clock: commerce and household access are scheduled around its recurring stations, so devotion supplies social time rather than merely occupying it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary worship branch is much nearer to the surface than the split-root image of fire used to straighten. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus inventory preserves that branch and the immediately preceding lamp is kindled within layered light. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory resonance, never as a replacement lexical meaning for prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins keeping prayer standing to a split prayer-root branch in which kindled heat straightens material.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and balance supply the condition toward which the maintained practice works.
Kindling and heat-straightening supply an exploratory material process for prayer's formative action.
Ignition of fire supplies the immediate contextual material that activates the distant prayer branch.
Distributed illumination contains the heat image within guidance rather than destructive burning.

changed_reading.before: Establishing prayer means reliably performing an obligation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repeated prayer is a luminous straightening process: a maintained heat reshapes orientation without being extinguished by commercial motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because trade makes ordinary sale the dominant local sense. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly preserves pledge and allegiance under the sale root, while 24:47-51 contrasts professed obedience with turning away. Downstream prose should mark this as a secondary covenantal overtone, not substitute pledge for the surface transaction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's sale root can also image a pledge of obedience, while its diversion construction asks what can draw allegiance away.

activation_trace.role: Pledged obedience supplies a secondary allegiance register inside the ordinary sale term.
Diversion supplies the possibility that a rival commitment could pull allegiance away.
Declared submission supplies the covenantal claim later tested by conduct.
Turning away supplies the failed allegiance against which the focus agents stand.
Hearing that becomes compliance supplies the durable alternative to verbal profession.

changed_reading.before: No commercial transaction interrupts their devotions.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary resonance, no rival bargain purchases their turning away: their remembered allegiance remains operative when obedience becomes costly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun conventionally identifies male human agents, not a mode of locomotion. It remains anchored through the same root's walking branch, the later two-legged creation sequence, and the earlier testimony of feet. Downstream prose should retain the ordinary human reference and offer accountable walking only as an embodied metonymic layer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's human-agent root also carries walking on feet, allowing non-distraction to be traced through bodily movement in the marketplace.

activation_trace.role: Walking on feet supplies an embodied trajectory beneath the ordinary designation of the agents.
Witnessing from presence turns the body's movement into later evidence.
Feet as bodily members supply the specific agents that testify to practiced routes.
Repeated walking and movement place human locomotion within a larger field of creaturely paths.
The explicit pair of feet supplies the bodily form that reactivates the focus root.

changed_reading.before: Exemplary men remain devout while conducting business.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are accountable walkers: the routes their feet take through exchange become testimony, yet those routes never redirect the inward path of remembrance.

strongest_changes: The light-house sequence turns private steadfastness into maintenance of a shared luminous devotional ecology.
The testimony and gaze sequences make the final turning of hearts and sights an accountability crisis for faculties that already construct social knowledge.
Reward, increase, provision, reckoning, and mirage recast trade and zakat as rival accounts of genuine yield.
The fear sequence distinguishes suspicious, advantage-sensitive fear from reverent fear that stabilizes obedience and opens toward security.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the focus verse operate simultaneously as luminous household maintenance, perceptual discipline, counter-accounting, affective reorientation, and social timekeeping. The split prayer root, pledge branch of sale, and walking branch of the human-agent root also preserved three contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact degree to which the agents causally maintain the light, rather than merely inhabit its houses, remains inferential.
The economic sequence may remeasure market valuation specifically or may use accounting language for a broader contrast of deeds.
The prayer-as-fire, sale-as-pledge, and accountable-walker readings are branch-backed resonances and should not displace nearer lexical senses.
The relation between disciplined perception now and involuntary sensory reversal later may be analogical rather than causal.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Two exchange systems compete for orientation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ل ه و` B001 is diversion from one concern by another; `ت ج ر` B001 is trade for profit; `ب ي ع` B001 is priced exchange and B003 a pledge of obedience; `ق و م` B004 is maintaining/standing over a practice; `ز ك و` B001 is growth; `ق ل ب` B004 is turning/reversal; `ب ص ر` B002 is inner sight. **Structural cue:** 24:32-33 place wealth inside marriage and release obligations, 24:35-36 establish light and recurrent remembrance, and 24:38 contrasts measured account with provision beyond account; 24:39-40 then show failed orientation. **Assigned role:** commerce can redirect attention, whereas maintained prayer and transferred growth constitute a rival pledge that fixes orientation; the feared day tests whether heart and sight remain stable. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies two flows of value and a possible turn; I infer sustained ritual transfer → resistance to commercial capture of attention. **Reading change:** the men are not outside economic life; they keep exchange from becoming the system that governs perception and allegiance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:38 made the competing economies explicit by moving from deed to surplus beyond account; 24:39-40 then showed what happens when perception is captured by a false valuation or loses orientation entirely.

baseline.text: Öyle adamlardır ki ne ticaret ne alışveriş onları Allah'ı anmaktan, namazı kılmaktan ve zekâtı vermekten alıkoyar. Kalplerin ve gözlerin altüst olacağı bir günden korkarlar.

findings.text: Ticaret reddedilmez; anma, namaz ve zekât, alışverişin dikkati ve değeri yöneten son ölçü olmasını engelleyen rakip bir değişim düzeni kurar.
Kalplerle gözlerin birlikte altüst olması, korkulan günde hem isteğin hem algının yön değiştireceğini gösterir; bugünkü süreklilik bu çift çözülmeye karşı bir algı eğitimidir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Daily Rhythm of Praise
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Worship recurs from early day to late afternoon, linking temporal endpoints through praise and formal prayer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: early-morning departure or interval `quranic:root_001076:B001/m01`; late-afternoon interval `quranic:root_000038:B003/m01`; worship through praise `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; formal embodied prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; bounded daytime period `quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, insan ve hayvanın bilinen bacak uzvunu çekirdek anlam olarak verir; koyunu bacağından asma, kişiyi bacağından yakalama ve iri bacaklı olma kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel türetimlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzvun temel anlamı, yalnız belirli yapılarda görülen asma, yakalama ve büyüklük anlamlarından ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim bacak uzvunu bildirir; asma ve yakalama eylemleriyle iri bacaklılık ise yalnız kendi türemiş biçimlerinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin yürümeye ve destek olmaya yarayan bacak uzvudur. Bu uzva bağlanan özel biçimler, bir hayvanı bacağından asmayı, birini bacağından yakalamayı veya iri bacaklı olmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, insanın ve çoğu hayvanın bilinen bacak uzvudur.
Uzva dayalı türemiş kullanımlar bacağından asma, bacağından yakalama ve iri bacaklı olma anlamlarını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bacak uzvunu ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve bu uzva dayanan üç özel kullanım alanını birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvan bedenindeki temel uzuv anlamında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız uzva bağlanan özel eylem biçimlerinde uygundur.

concept_map.definition: Bir taşıta veya bineğe binmeden kendi bacaklarıyla yürüyen kişi ya da böyle kişiler topluluğudur. Özel yapılarda yürümeye dayanıklılığı, bineğinden inerek yaya olmayı ve yürünmesi güç taşlık araziyi de anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yapının bir kişinin devrini veya zamanını belirttiği konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir olayın belirli bir kişinin yaşadığı veya etkili olduğu dönemde gerçekleştiğini belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Zamanı belirli bir kişinin dönemiyle ilişkilendirmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dönemi gündelik ve doğal bir ifadeyle anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Olayı kişinin dönemi içine yerleştirir.
Bir zaman dilimi anlamını korur.
error_profile.adds: Belirli bir kişiyle bağ kurulmadan geniş bir tarihsel dönem anlamı ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zamanı belirli bir kişinin dönemi olarak sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gün, gece, akşam veya uzun dönem gibi çeşitli zaman dilimlerini bağımsız olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da olayların içinde gerçekleştiği zamanı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kişiyle kurulması zorunludur; komşu ise kişi bağlantısı gerektirmeyen genel ve özel zaman adlarını kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; kişi merkezli dönem yapısının genel zaman adlarından ayrımını en iyi gösteren aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: قولهم كان ذلك على رجل فلان أي في عهده وزمانه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس رجل الإنسان ولا الراجل
branches.source_phrase_ar: كان ذاك على رجل فلان أي في زمانه (maqayis)؛ كان ذلك على رجل فلان أي في عهده وزمانه (sihah)؛ استعير الرجل لزمان الإنسان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade at veya başka bir hayvanın bacaklarından yalnız birinde bulunan beyazlığı özel bir görünüş niteliği olarak tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nitelik tek bacaktaki beyaz lekeyle sınırlıdır; bacağın büyüklüğü veya hayvanın yürüyüş biçimi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız at veya başka bir hayvanı tek bacağındaki beyazlıkla niteleyen yapıda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Atın veya başka bir hayvanın bacaklarından birinin beyaz olmasıyla oluşan ayırt edici renk niteliğidir.

facets.statement: Nitelik, hayvanın yalnız bir bacağında görülen beyazlığa dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar at veya başka bir hayvanın bir bacağındaki beyazlığı aynı ayırt edici renk özelliği olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: At veya başka bir hayvan tek bacağındaki beyazlıkla nitelendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beyazlığın hayvanın tek bacağında bulunması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelik özellikle bir atın görünüşü açıklanırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Atı ve tek bacaktaki beyaz işareti birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir bacağında beyazlık bulunan at veya başka bir hayvan

error_profile.preserves: At üzerindeki renk ayrımını korur.
error_profile.adds: Beyazlığın tek bacakla sınırlı olmadığı genel bir alacalılık ekler.
error_profile.collision: Gövdeye yayılan başka renk desenleriyle karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Beyazlığı hayvanın tek bacağında arar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birden çok ayağın belirli dizilişlerde beyaz olmasını veya olmamasını ayırt eder.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: tek bacak beyazlığı ile ayak deseni
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da atların bacaklarındaki beyaz işaretleri sınıflandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için bir bacağın beyazlığı yeterlidir; komşu, beyaz ayakların belirli karşılıklı ya da çapraz düzenine bağlı daha özel bir işarettir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Beyazlık yalnız bir bacakta bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Beyazlık başın veya yüzün tamamını kaplar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de hayvanda beyaz rengin yerini belirten görünüş nitelikleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ayırt edici bölge farklıdır: odakta tek bacak, komşuda baş veya yüz bütünü beyazdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün renk ve hayvan niteliği adayları karşılaştırıldı; tek bacak koşulunu düzenli ayak deseninden ve yüz beyazlığından ayıran iki aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: الأرجل من الدواب والخيل الذي في إحدى رجليه بياض؛ الأنثى رجلاء؛ الشاة رجلاء كذلك
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس عظم الرِّجل؛ ليس صفة المشي
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأرجل من الدواب الذي ابيض أحد رجليه (maqayis)؛ الرجلة أيضا مصدر الأرجل من الدواب بإحدى رجليه بياض (ayn)؛ فرس أرجل والأنثى رجلاء إذا كان في إحدى رجليه بياض (jamhara)؛ الأرجل من الخيل الذي في إحدى رجليه بياض (sihah)؛ الأرجل الأبيض الرجل من الفرس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade özellikle çekirgelerden oluşan büyük bir parça, küme veya sürüyü bildirir; bazı anlatımlar benzer yaratık topluluklarına sınırlı bir genişleme de tanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir çekirgeyi değil, çok sayıda çekirgenin oluşturduğu belirgin topluluğu adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Topluluk anlamı yalnız çekirgeyle kurulan belirtili yapıya bağlıdır ve çıplak köke genel bir topluluk anlamı vermez.

concept_map.definition: Çok sayıda çekirgenin bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan büyük küme, parça veya sürüdür; kullanımın merkezi çekirge topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, çok sayıda çekirgeden oluşan büyük ve toplu bir kümedir.
Bir tanıklık aynı topluluk tasarımını çekirgeye benzer yaratık kümelerine de sınırlı biçimde genişletir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar büyük çekirge topluluğu çekirdeğinde birleşir; daha geniş yaratık topluluğu ifadesi merkeze bağlı sınırlı bir uzantıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çok sayıdaki çekirgenin birlikte oluşturduğu belirgin topluluk için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirge türünü, çokluğu ve topluluk niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun sürüden çok bir araya yığılmış parça olarak görüldüğü bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirgelerin toplu bir parça oluşturmasını korur.
Çok sayıda varlığın bir aradalığını korur.
error_profile.adds: Çekirge koşulunu kaldırarak her türlü insan veya varlık topluluğunu ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çekirgelerin oluşturduğu sürüyü veya kümeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çekirge türünü ve bitkiyi yiyip sıyırma etkisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak konusu çekirgedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın zorunlu öğesi çokluk ve topluluktur; komşu ise tekil veya tür adı olarak çekirgeyi ve onun bitkiye verdiği zararı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir çekirge topluluğunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çekirge dahil birçok şeyin dağıtılıp yayılma hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Çekirge sürüsü hareket ederken yayılma görünümü gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bir topluluk adıdır; komşu ise nesnelerin veya canlıların dağılıp çevreye yayılması olayını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün topluluk ve çekirge adayları değerlendirildi; sürü adını tür adından ve yayılma olayından ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: الرَّجْل جماعة أو قطعة عظيمة من الجراد ونحوه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس رجلا من الناس؛ ليس رجلا ماشيا
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرجل القطيع من الجراد ونحوه من الخلق (ayn)؛ رأيت رجلا من جراد أي قطعة عظيمة (jamhara)؛ الرجل أيضا الجماعة الكثيرة من الجراد خاصة (sihah)؛ استعير الرجل للقطعة من الجراد (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade birincil olarak semizotu diye bilinen otu verir; ayrıca tuzcul bir bitki, belirli bir çalının yetiştiği yer ve kereviz için kullanılan ayrı bir bitki adı da aynı dalda tanıklanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bitki adları alanındadır; su yolları anlamı buraya katılmaz ve kereviz kullanımı ayrı bir sözcük biçimine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal tanıklanan bitki adlarıyla sınırlıdır; su yatağı veya başka yapılara özgü anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Başlıca semizotu diye bilinen bir otu adlandırır; bazı tanıklıklarda tuzcul bir bitki veya belirli bir çalının bol yetiştiği yer de bu adla ilişkilendirilir. Ayrı bir çoğul biçim kerevizi belirtir.

facets.statement: Temel bitki adı, çoğunlukla semizotu diye bilinen yenebilir ota yönelir.
Tanıklıklarda tuzcul bir bitki ve belirli bir çalının bol yetiştiği yer biçiminde farklılaştırılmış açıklamalar da vardır.
Ayrı bir sözcük biçimi, bahçe bitkisi olan kerevizin adı olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bitki alanında birleşmekle birlikte semizotu, tuzcul bitki, yetişme yeri ve ayrı biçimde kereviz açıklamalarını birlikte taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın en yaygın ve doğrudan bitki adı olan temel kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Temel ot adını ve semizotu tanımlamasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Tuzcul bitki, yetişme yeri ve ayrı kereviz biçimi uzantılarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kerevizi bildiren ayrı çoğul sözcük biçimi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrı biçimin kereviz bitkisini adlandırmasını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: semizotu diye anılan ot; bazı tanıklıklarda tuzcul bitki

error_profile.preserves: Bitki ve ot alanını korur.
error_profile.adds: Tanıklanan belirli bitki adlarının dışındaki bütün yeşil bitkileri kapsama ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir otu ve ayrı biçimde kerevizi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağaç olmayan taze yeşil bitkilerin genel sınıfını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ağaç olmayan yenebilir veya taze bitkiler alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli bitki adlarına bağlıdır; komşu ise çok sayıda türü kapsayan genel bir bitki sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün bitki ve kardeş adaylar değerlendirildi; belirli bitki adını genel ot sınıfından ayıran karşılaştırma en yararlı sınır olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: الرِّجلة بقلة أو نبت؛ البقلة الحمقاء؛ منبت العرفج؛ التراجيل الكرفس
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مسايل الماء وإن ارتبطت بعض المصادر بمنبتها
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرجلة هي التي يقال لها البقلة الحمقاء (maqayis)؛ الرجلة منبت العرفج الكثير (ayn)؛ التراجيل الكرفس (ayn)؛ الرجلة نبت من الحمض (jamhara)؛ الرجلة بقلة وتسمى الحمقاء (sihah)؛ الرجلة البقلة الحمقاء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade suyun aktığı yolların çoğulunu ve bunlardan her birinin tekil adını açıkça verir; bitki adıyla olan biçim benzerliği anlam ortaklığı oluşturmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız suyun aktığı doğal yol veya yataktır; bu yatakta yetişebilecek bitkiyi adlandırmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Su yolu anlamı yalnız suyla kurulan yapıda geçerlidir ve kökün çıplak biçimine genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Suyun doğal olarak aktığı yollardan ve yataklardan her biridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, suyun içinden aktığı tek bir doğal akış yolu veya yatağıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sözcüğü su akış yollarından birinin tekil adı olarak aynı biçimde açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Suyun izleyerek aktığı tek bir doğal küçük yol veya yatak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun aktığı yol ve yatak niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğal bir akış yatağı kastedildiğinde uygun bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Tekil ve doğal akış yolu anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: suyun aktığı tek bir doğal yol veya yatak

error_profile.preserves: Akan su ve yatağı fikrini korur.
error_profile.adds: Daha büyük, sürekli ve belirgin bir akarsu olma çağrışımı ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Herhangi bir tekil doğal su akış yolunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uzaktan gelip suyun toplandığı yere dökülen yan kolları özellikle bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: su yolu ile besleyici yan kol
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da suyu taşıyan doğal küçük yatakları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yön ve varış koşulu koymaz; komşu akış yolunun uzaktan gelip bir su birikimine ulaşmasını gerekli kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğal akış yatağını genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Küçük nehri veya bir havuzdan su alan düzenli kanalı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de suyun izlediği dar bir yolu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta doğal yatak ve akış yolu esastır; komşuda küçük nehir veya kanala benzeyen daha belirgin bir su yolu öne çıkar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün su ve kardeş adaylar değerlendirildi; genel akış yatağını besleyici yan koldan ve küçük kanaldan ayıran iki aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: الرِّجْلة واحدة مسايل الماء؛ الرجل مسايل الماء
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النبات النابت في المسيل
branches.source_phrase_ar: قال قوم بل الرجل مسايل الماء واحدتها رجلة (maqayis)؛ الرجلة أيضا واحدة الرجل وهي مسايل الماء (sihah)؛ استعير الرجل لمسيل الماء الواحدة رجلة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade üç kalıplaşmış adlandırmayı birlikte tanıklar: yayın bir kolu, kuş ayağı biçimli bir damga ve yavrunun emmesini önleyen bir meme bağı. Yay kolunun üst mü alt mı olduğu konusunda tanıklıklar ayrışır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ortak bir ayak benzetmesine dayanan üç ayrı yapıyla sınırlıdır; yayın hangi kolunun kastedildiği kesinleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Her anlam yalnız kendi kalıplaşmış yapısında geçerlidir; yay parçası, damga ve meme bağı tek bir çıplak kök anlamı gibi birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Ayak biçimi veya işlevi benzetmesiyle kurulan üç özel adlandırma alanıdır: yayın üst ya da alt kolu, kuş ayağı biçimindeki damga ve yavrunun emmesini engelleyen meme bağı.

facets.statement: Yayın ayak diye adlandırılan kolu bazı tanıklıklarda üst, bazılarında alt kol olarak belirlenir.
Kuş ayağı adı, kuş ayağına benzeyen belirli bir damga türünü bildirir.
Karga ayağı adı, dişi devenin memelerini bağlayıp yavrunun emmesini engelleyen bir düzeni bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üç kalıplaşmış adı destekler; yay parçasının üst veya alt kol oluşu ise kaynaklar arasında çözülemeyen bir yön ayrımı taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yay kolu, kuş ayağı biçimli damga ve meme bağı kullanımlarını dal düzeyinde birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Üç kullanımın ayrı yapılara bağlı adlandırmalar olduğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yay parçası kastedildiğinde ve tanıklıklardaki yön ayrılığı korunarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Parçanın yay kolu olduğunu ve yönün tartışmalı kaldığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi devenin memelerinin bağlanmasıyla ilgili özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağın yerini ve emzirmeyi engelleme işlevini korur.
Adlandırmaların ayak veya bacak benzetmesini çağrıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Yay parçası, damga ve bağ olarak kalıplaşmış üç özel nesneyi kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Gerçek beden uzvu anlamını öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün beden uzvu dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yayın üst ya da alt kolunu adlandırır ve ayrıca iki başka kalıplaşmış nesneyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yayda telin bağlandığı uçtan yayın en son noktasına kadar olan özel kısmı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yayın yapısındaki bir parçayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak tanıklıklarında üst veya alt kol ayrımı vardır; komşu ise tel bağının ötesindeki uç bölümünü daha kesin bir yapısal sınırla belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yayın kolunu genel bir parça adı olarak verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yay kollarının uçlarındaki kıvrım veya sargı bölümlerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kullanım yayın kolları çevresindeki yapısal parçalarla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak daha geniş bir kol adıdır; komşu kolların uçlarındaki belirli kıvrım veya sargı bölgesini sınırlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün yay, damga, bağ ve kardeş adaylar değerlendirildi; dalın en karışabilir yay parçası sınırını açıklayan iki aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: رجل القوس سيتها؛ رجل الطائر ميسم؛ رجل الغراب ضرب من صر أخلاف النوق
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الرِّجل العضو نفسه؛ ليس جماعة الجراد
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل القوس سيتها العليا (maqayis)؛ رجل القوس سيتها السفلى (ayn;sihah)؛ رجل الطائر ضرب من الميسم (maqayis)؛ رجل الطائر ميسم (sihah)؛ رجل الغراب ضرب من صر أخلاف النوق (maqayis)؛ رجل الغراب ضرب من الابل لا يقدر الفصل على أن يرضع معه (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade saçın ne çok kıvırcık ne de dümdüz olan ara yapısını ve saçı tarayıp düzene sokma eylemini aynı alanın iki ayrı biçimi olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Saçın doğal ara dokusu ile saçı tarama eylemi ayrılmalı; hiçbiri genel erkek kişi veya günün yükselmesi anlamına taşınmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Saç niteliği yalnız ilgili sıfat yapısında, tarama anlamı ise ilgili eylem biçiminde geçerlidir; iki kapsam birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Saçın sıkı kıvırcıkla dümdüz arasında kalan doğal dokusunu bildirir. Buna bağlı ayrı eylem biçimi, saçı tarayıp düzenlemeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Saç dokusu ne çok kıvırcık ne de bütünüyle düzdür.
Ayrı eylem biçimi saçı tarayarak düzgün bir görünüme kavuşturmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar ara saç dokusunu ve saçı tarayıp düzenleme eylemini aynı kök alanının ayrı kullanımları olarak destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Saç ne sıkı kıvırcık ne de dümdüz olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Saçın iki uç arasında kalan dokusunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Saçın taranması ve görünüşünün düzenlenmesi eyleminde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tarama ve düzenleme eylemini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ne çok kıvırcık ne dümdüz olan saç

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kişinin dikkatini veya uğraşını başka yöne çekerek onu belirli bir şeyden alıkoymasıdır. Katılımcı düzenine göre kişi bir şeyi unutup bırakabilir ya da başkasını başka bir şeyle avutabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, kişinin ilgisini başka yöne çekerek onu belirli bir şeyden alıkoyar.
Kişi, başka bir uğraşa yönelerek bir şeyi anmayı bırakır, onu terk eder veya ondan yüz çevirir.
Bir kimse başkasını bir şeyle avutabilir, oyalayabilir ve böylece başka bir işten alıkoyabilir.

facets.statement: Kişi oyun oynayarak, neşe duyarak veya zevk veren bir şeyle uğraşarak eğlenir.
Eğlenme alanı, kadın veya çocuk için doğrudan ad vermeyen örtmeceli bir anlatıma dönüşebilir.
Aynı eğlenme alanı, cinsel birleşmeyi doğrudan söylemeden anlatan bir örtmece olarak kullanılabilir.
Karşılıklı oyalanma ve bilmece benzeri ortak eğlence türleri, oyun çekirdeğinin yapıya bağlı uzantılarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak anatomik adı verir; başka dallardaki değirmen, armağan, oyun veya alıkoyma anlamlarını bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Ağız tavanının en gerisinden boğaza doğru sarkan küçük et parçasıdır. Bazı açıklamalarda gönderge daha geniş tutularak ağzın en arka bölgesi diye verilir.

facets.statement: Ağız tavanının gerisinde bulunan ve boğazın üzerine doğru sarkan küçük et parçasını belirtir.
Bazı açıklamalar belirli et parçası yerine daha geniş olarak ağzın en arka bölgesini gönderge sayar.
Bir açıklama anatomik adın gerekçesini, yiyeceğin ağızdan geçerken bu bölgeye ulaşmasına bağlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak odağı ağız ile boğazın birleştiği en arka bölgedir. Baskın tanım burada sarkan küçük et parçasını gösterir; daha geniş bir açıklama ağzın en arkasını öne çıkarır, bir adlandırma açıklaması da yiyeceğin bu bölgeye ulaşmasına dayanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Verilen kaynak ifadesi, sermaye veya mal üzerinde kazanc elde etmek icin is yapmayi, bu isi yapan kisiyi ve bu isten elde edilen karlilik baglamini birlikte verir. Gecici cerceve bu cekirdegi dogru yakalar; yalniz deve satisindaki ragbet, bu is icin gidilen yer ve bir konuda ustalik ayri kollarda tutulmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol, kazanc amacli mal isletme ve onun failini kapsar; yer, hayvan satisi ve beceri anlamlari buna katilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Cekirdek fiil ve ad bicimleriyle birlikte bir karlilik kalibi vardir; tanim hem genel alisveris isini hem de bu ise bagli kar baglamini ayirarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Kisi ya da topluluk, sermaye veya mali kazanc elde etmek icin alir, satar ve isletir; bu is, onu yapan kimseyi ve alisveristen kar saglama durumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Ana cekirdek, sermaye veya mal uzerinde kazanc hedefiyle alis satis yapma ve onu isletmedir.
Ayni alan, bu isi yapan kisi veya kisiler icin kullanilan fail ve topluluk anlatimini da tasir.
Belirli bir alis satis isinde kar elde etme, cekirdege bagli sonuc baglami olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu kolu bilinen alis satis isi, sermayeyi kazanc istegiyle kullanma, bu isi yapan kisi ve topluluk, ayrica belirli bir alis satis isinden kar saglama olarak bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Cekirdek anlam icin en kisa dogal karsiliktir; hem mali isletmeyi hem kar hedefini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Mal veya sermaye uzerinden kazanc amacli is yapma cekirdegini korur.

Satilan sey, satici-alici ikilisi, ticaret mallari ve karsilikli alisveris adlari bu islemin bagli kullanimlaridir.
Baskasinin alisi uzerine araya girip satin almamayi bildiren kalip, cekirdegin belirli bir ticaret ortami icindeki kullanimidir.
